teile.name: Hidden tokens
teile.text: Thousands of hidden tokens load before your question. Claude Code does it, but why, and can you shrink it?
teile.szene: Black-haired presenter in black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses sits at a desk in a dim apartment at night, brow furrowed, typing a short question, city lights behind him. Medium shot, painted open-world-game poster style, bold ink contours.

teile.name: Token overhead
teile.text: Systima measured about 33,000 tokens in Claude Code before a one-line prompt arrived. OpenCode used about 7,000 on the same model.
teile.szene: Systima blog post section comparing Claude Code and OpenCode token overhead on a one-line reply.

teile.name: Instruction file
teile.text: So what fills it? Systima says a 72KB instruction file adds about 20,000 tokens on average per request.
teile.szene: Systima blog passage on a 72KB instruction file adding about 20,000 tokens to every request.

teile.name: Starting depth
teile.text: Five modest MCP servers add 5,000 to 7,000 more. Systima says a real setup starts 75,000 to 85,000 tokens deep.
teile.szene: Systima blog passage on MCP servers adding 5,000 to 7,000 tokens and a working setup starting 75,000 to 85,000 tokens deep.

teile.name: Spending caps
teile.text: Can you cap spending? Docs list max turns, max budget for scripted runs, and a spend limit you set.
teile.szene: Official Claude Code best practices documentation table row on how much it spends: max turns, max budget and a spend limit.

teile.name: Keep it lean
teile.text: Docs advise noting only what Claude can't find in your code. Your question never travels alone, but you shape its company.
teile.szene: Presenter with cyan glasses and black leather jacket leans back in a dim apartment at night, thoughtful relieved smile, hands behind his head, city lights behind him. Medium shot, warm lamp light, painted open-world-game poster style.

teile.name: Engagement
teile.text: Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: Presenter with glowing cyan glasses and black leather jacket smiles and gives a thumbs up on a calm city rooftop at dusk. Medium shot, warm light, painted open-world-game poster style.

entwurf.beschreibung: Systima measured about 33,000 tokens in Claude Code before a one-line prompt arrived, versus about 7,000 in OpenCode. Anthropic's docs name max turns, max budget and a spend limit.
